story.title: Tailscale didn't stop the Hugging Face intrusion

draft:
I've been following the Hugging Face intrusion and was surprised to learn that Tailscale didn't prevent the breach. 
The incident highlights the limitations of zero-trust networks. 
Key takeaways from the incident include:
* Overreliance on a single security solution
* Importance of continuous monitoring
I'm left wondering, what's the best way to layer security solutions for maximum protection?
#cybersecurity #zerotrust #networksecurity
